The *Sabbakittikattheraapadāna* is a verse narrative preserved in the *Therāpadāna* section of the Pali canon [SuttaCentral]. It recounts the biographical verses and past karmic deeds associated with the elder Sabbakittika. SuttaCentral records five translations in five modern languages, though it does not list an English title or curated canonical parallels [SuttaCentral].

In addition, stock verses and shared narrative phrasing are distributed across numerous other poems within the *Therāpadāna*, showing notable overlap with texts such as the *Bākulattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 398), the *Padumakūṭāgāriyattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 397), and the *Girimānandattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 399) [DharmaNexus].
